name: instance-pool
description: A controlled pool for non-component resources (iframes, workers, independent JS runtimes, connections) that need to be pre-warmed idle, claimed by a session, and cooled down for reuse instead of torn down immediately. If you only need to pool framework components, use Vue's <KeepAlive> or react-activation instead — this package is for resources those tools cannot manage.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node ../../scripts/write-dual-pkg.mjs dist
